faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our play space and bookings.

items.question: What are the booking rates?
items.answer: A standard table booking starts at €2 per hour per player, or is free when purchasing drinks/snacks or booster packs in the shop.

items.question: Do I need to bring my own cards?
items.answer: Yes, for open play and constructed tournaments, you must bring your own decks. However, we sell booster packs, starter decks, and occasionally lend out demo decks.

items.question: How do I register for a TCG or board game tournament?
items.answer: You can register directly online on the 'Tournaments' page or in person at the shop's front desk up to 15 minutes before the event starts.

items.question: Can we bring outside food or drinks?
items.answer: We have a café area with hot/cold drinks and snacks. To protect the tables and other players' cards, outside food and drinks are not allowed.
